conditions: Instantaneous power absorbed by a lumped two-terminal element; current is positive when entering the terminal designated positive for voltage. Average AC power generally requires time averaging.
spoken_aliases: instantaneous electrical power equals instantaneous current times instantaneous voltage

evidence: For a two-terminal lumped element under the passive sign convention, energy delivered by charge dq entering the positive terminal is V dq. Divide by dt to obtain V I, with I=dq/dt. A negative value means delivery rather than absorption.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/9-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
